comment.narrative: The establishment of the Needs Assessment and Referral Unit NARU in the Municipality of Kamza represents a significant advancement in the local capacity to address social challenges particularly for vulnerable groups such as victims of domestic violence the elderly and individuals with disabilities. Under the guidance of the Counseling Line for Women and Girls the project achieved remarkable progress by designing and implementing the Protocols and Standard Procedures for the Operation of the NARU as well as templates for referrals of cases that were amended and adjusted to respond to the municipal context which received official approval from Kamza Municipality on January 24 2024. This milestone marked the first implementation of such protocols signifying a major institutional development.
